_about: The presentation standard every screen of the web app must meet — the governing section of docs/DESIGN_BRIEF.md (rendered by scripts/project_docs/design.py) and a requirement in docs/PRODUCT_REQUIREMENTS.md. One record, so every reader states the same rules.
recorded_from: the product owner's instruction of 2026-10-16, relayed by the main working session
applies_to: everything built and everything still to be built

rules.title: Customer language only
rules.rule: Only external-facing, customer language on screen.

rules.title: Little text on the main screen; detail on demand
rules.rule: As little text as possible on the main UI; further detail in a drill-down pop-up (Dialog or Drawer) with professionally written, structured text.

rules.title: Visual first
rules.rule: As much visual representation as possible on the main UI.

known_breaches.note: breaks the standard and will be reworked; its text is not the house style
